workshoptitle: Build Connected Transportation Solutions with Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Meet Seer Transport and the passenger service decisions explored in the workshop.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Open the LiveLabs database environment and SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Operations Query
tutorials.description: Combine disruption reports, text similarity, booking activity, and station locations in one SQL result.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build a JSON Booking Model
tutorials.description: Compare JSON columns, collections, and relational duality for a passenger booking application.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Review a Semantic Service Search
tutorials.description: Find services related to a disruption description and review their associated bookings and passengers.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Investigate a Service Disruption Network
tutorials.description: Trace connected trips, routes, stations, vehicles, and cases with SQL/PGQ and Graph Studio.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Route Passengers to the Closest Station
tutorials.description: Use Oracle Spatial to match passengers in a service region with active stations.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Build a Service Demand Watchlist
tutorials.description: Train and score an in-database demand model using synthetic service activity.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Transportation Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Inspect generated SQL for service, booking, passenger, and fare questions.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Transportation Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Run a transportation question through an approved SQL tool and inspect its history.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding with scored questions.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
